presets.label: Legacy v1-500
presets.description: Maestro's previous six-step default, retained as a rollback option for comparisons or prompts that worked better with the earlier adapter.

presets.label: Current v4-600 EMA
presets.description: Maestro's previous standard-LoRA default and the upstream-recommended EMA checkpoint. It remains available for comparisons and targets stronger faces, fingers, fine texture, and static or small-motion detail using six evaluations at strength 1.0.

presets.label: Alibaba PAI FL2VA Acc — 8-step PDD
presets.description: Maestro's default FL2VA Turbo recipe and Alibaba PAI's official Parallel Decoding Distillation adapter. Maestro applies its required 32-interval, four-at-a-time head fusion and eight model evaluations at strength 1.0.

presets.label: Alibaba PAI Ref2VA Acc — 8-step PDD
presets.description: Maestro's default Ref2VA Turbo recipe and Alibaba PAI's official Parallel Decoding Distillation adapter for H3 Omni. Maestro applies its required 32-interval, four-at-a-time head fusion and eight model evaluations at strength 1.0. The official recipe recommends 2048px-short-edge references; Match output remains available as a faster no-upscale option. Published Ref2VA PDD examples currently cover clips through 10.13 seconds, so longer accelerated clips remain experimental.
